f75364f910b83ebd920321e3dcf66729d932693d.sourceText: 所以，近处点密集的块可能很快更新，远处点少的块可能等到时间门槛，旧点保留超过0.2秒。没有新扫描时也不会单靠计时继续处理。`noDecayDis=0.0` 没有免衰减区域；以后调大，只让指定范围的自身历史绕过年龄检查，不会自动恢复近场缺失的输出。
f75364f910b83ebd920321e3dcf66729d932693d.translatedText: Therefore, blocks with dense points nearby may be updated quickly, while blocks with few points far away may wait until the time threshold, with old points retained for more than 0\.2 seconds\. When there is no new scan, processing will not continue based solely on the timer\.`noDecayDis=0.0`There is no decay\-free region; if increased later, it only allows the self\-history within a specified range to bypass the age check, and will not automatically restore the missing output in the near field\.
